info.title: Click Backend API
info.description: Android 설정 앱 위 오버레이 안내를 위한 MVP API

schema.title: Response Current Consents Api V1 Users  User Id  Consents Get

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: Parent node_id within this snapshot; null for a root or legacy flat payload

visible_to_user.title: Visible To User
visible_to_user.description: Android isVisibleToUser; hidden nodes are not guide targets

bounds_in_screen.title: Bounds In Screen
bounds_in_screen.description: Screen pixel rectangle [left, top, right, bottom]; the client converts to overlay-local coordinates when drawing

AccessibilityNode.title: AccessibilityNode
AccessibilityNode.description: Android AccessibilityNode payload accepted at the BE/Agent boundary.

screen_name.title: Screen Name
screen_name.description: Registered task graph state ID; never a screen title or user text

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Only step, duration_ms, attempt_count (nonnegative integers <= 86400000) and explanation_depth (concise/normal/detailed)

target_bounds.title: Target Bounds
target_bounds.description: Target control rectangle in screen pixels [left, top, right, bottom]; not dp or overlay-local coordinates

redaction_applied.title: Redaction Applied
redaction_applied.description: Client hint only; does not authorize external image processing

screenshot_base64.title: Screenshot Base64
screenshot_base64.description: Discarded: external image processing is disabled until server-side redaction is available; send on-device OCR elements
